description: ADS-B / Mode S (T-015): readsb exec'd as a subprocess behind hk-plugin-readsb, which converts ci8 -> UC8 and parses --raw output into NDJSON decode lines. The wrapper reports ready once readsb's Beast connection and the pre-roll are in place (1.6 s under load, T-223), so limits.ready_timeout_ms is set explicitly to the 5 s default: ~3x that worst case, and a live chain reads no samples while it waits. See docs/stream-contract.md §9.3 and §9.6.
